_about: Contractor: Fallen's people's lines (docs/survival_people.md section 5, call 54/76). A topic lists lines; a line's tags must all be the speaker's (TalkMenu.tags_of: status, mood band, scared/cocky, traits, want kind, disposition, grudge) and the most specific match wins, ties picked at random. Untagged lines are the fallback. {name} {first} {want} {zone} {background} {item} fill in. Short and plain: the TTS voices them later.

greet.text: I'm {first}. That's all you need for now.
Stay back. Please. I don't want any trouble.
Don't come closer. I mean it. I'm just {first}.
Look what crawled in. You lost, or just stupid?
{first}. And this is my patch, so talk fast.
Oh thank god, a living face. I'm {first}.
{first}. Not that names matter much now.
It's me, {first}. Who else would it be.

warn.text: Hands where I can see them!
Keep walking. I've got nothing for you.

want.text: You want me along? Then I want {want}.
Cash still talks to me. {want}, and I come with you.
{want}. Do that for me and we'll talk.
I just want {want}. Somewhere I can sleep.
I'll come. I'd rather not be alone anymore.

place.text: {zone}? Quiet in the day. Don't trust the nights.
I came through {zone} on foot. The dead sit in the houses.
The church still had food last week. Maybe.
Every place is the same now. Empty or full of them.

trade.text: I'll trade when you've got something worth it.
Fair's fair. What are you carrying?

trade_no.text: I don't do the trading. Ask around.

trade_unfair.text: Put more on the table or walk.

trade_done.text: Pleasure. Come back when you've more.
Good trade. Stay safe out there.

rumour_none.text: I haven't heard anything about that.

recruit_yes.text: Deal. Don't make me regret it.
Thank you. Thank you. I'll pull my weight.

recruit_no.text: Not yet. You know what I want.
Come back with {want}. Then we'll talk.
You haven't done it yet. I'd know.
Where would I even sleep? Find a place first.
Not with you. Not after that.

threaten_calm.text: Put that down. Nobody needs to die today.

how_are_you.text: Good, actually. Feels like we've got a chance.
Not great. I keep thinking about before.
I can't do this much longer.

think.text: We're doing alright. Keep it quiet and keep moving.
We should push harder. They're slow.

hungry.text: I'm out of food. Anyone got a tin?
I need to eat something soon.

thirsty.text: I need water. I'm all out.

ate.text: Eating something, give me a second.

plan_dusk.text: We should find somewhere before dark.
Getting dark. Let's get walls around us.

plan_horde.text: There's a horde out there. We need to go quiet.
That's a lot of them. Let's not be here.

plan_idle.text: I know a clinic two towns over. Might be worth it.
That smoke earlier. Could be a camp.
We need more water before tomorrow.

refuse_order.text: No. Not in there. That's a horde.
You go if you want. I'm not walking into that.
I can't. I'm sorry, I can't.

refuse_again.text: Ask me a hundred times. Still no.

obey_grudging.text: If you say so. I'm with you.

grief.text: We should bury them. We owe them that.

bury_thanks.text: Thank you. They'd have wanted that.

put_down.text: That wasn't them anymore. It wasn't.

newcomer.text: Who are you? Where's the one who led us?

break_crying.text: I can't. I just need a minute. I can't.

break_rage.text: I'm sick of this! Sick of all of it!

break_binge.text: Leave me alone. I'm having this.

break_hiding.text: I'm not going out there. Not today.

break_desertion.text: I'm done. Don't come after me.

break_refusal.text: Don't ask me anything. I won't.

favour_done.text: You did it? Then I keep my word.

favour_marked.text: I marked it on your map. Don't take forever.
